description: CONNECTIONS of one EU act, in both directions: what amended, repealed or replaced it, and what IT amended or rests on, plus the CJEU judgments that interpret it. Direction matters — 'what changed this regulation' and 'what did this regulation change' are opposite questions and this separates them. Use before relying on an act, to see whether it still says what you think.

kind.description: Optional filter: modifica, abroga, inlocuieste, rectifica, temei, interpreteaza. Default: all.
